title: 策略师谢毅哲：工业政策比消费刺激更有效
speaker: Unnamed Guest

segments.en: What kind of guidance do you think will hear from Chinese corporate? Does we enter the earnings issue? They would try to divert market attention onto the X-Watt.
segments.zh: 你认为会听到中国企业什么样的指引？我们进入财报季了吗？他们会试图将市场注意力转移到海外。

segments.en: And in fact this will be the growth driver. Which it is? Yeah, because if you look at domestic market, penetration is already 50-ish percent. How much more are you gonna gain from it?
segments.zh: 实际上这将是增长驱动力。是吗？是的，因为看国内市场，渗透率已经50%左右。还能从中获得多少增长？

segments.en: And then they probably have no hope of lifting prices. I mean, especially if they can keep the current prices at bar.
segments.zh: 而且他们可能没有希望提价。我是说，尤其如果它们能维持当前价格水平。

segments.en: Everyone's looking at the Politburo in July, as potential maybe some action could be taken. I don't know, what are your expectations? Because given the exports are still so strong that it's with this AI boom, does it only delay further stimulus?
segments.zh: 大家都在看7月政治局会议，可能采取一些行动。我不知道，你的预期是什么？因为出口仍然强劲，加上AI热潮，这是否只是推迟了进一步刺激？

segments.en: I think they would still advocate about the support and innovation, which they already done. Okay, so we had a very weak May retail sales. The anecdotal evidence looks like June is not a ninth number.
segments.zh: 我认为他们仍会倡导支持和创新，他们已经做了。好吧，5月零售销售非常疲弱。坊间证据显示6月也不是好数字。

segments.en: So as a result, there might be some support onto domestic consumption, but I don't think it's something like very significant. That could move the domestic market.
segments.zh: 因此，可能会对国内消费有一些支持，但我不认为会非常显著，足以推动国内市场。

segments.en: So let's focus on industrial policy. I think retroactively, if you followed, if you traded on industrial policy, you would have done better than the index. What are the lasting, the more consistent themes that you think will deliver performance in markets, looking at policy priorities in China?
segments.zh: 所以让我们关注工业政策。我认为回顾过去，如果你遵循工业政策进行交易，你的表现会好于指数。你认为哪些持久、更一致的主题会在市场中带来表现，看中国的政策重点？
